evidence.reason: `_expand_instance` substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the still-escaped instance text. systemd defines `%I` as the unescaped instance name, so for a unit such as `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` resolves to `crq-tick.service`; the code instead produces `crq\x2dtick.service` and the scan misses the reference. This is an implementation defect in the existing expansion behavior, not a new requirement.
